info.title: Astro Bridge Local API
info.description: Native mobile API. HTTP recovery remains available; optional device-local HTTPS requires supported diskless OS helpers and explicit client CA trust. Tokens bind to actual transport. Passwords and private keys are never returned. Accepted operations are asynchronous.

radio_id.description: Opaque identifier for this service run, never a MAC address.

current_clock.description: Observation at the last diagnostic job, never continuing sync proof.
